mintAuthority.summary: Canonical Ethereum shares mint through the USDat ERC-4626 vault, with base issuance inherited from USDat. Local UUPS logic is role-controlled and the observed default admin is a five-day timelock. One-hour parameter administration and operator-recognized STRCon accounting remain separate controls. The complete role/bypass census and financial reconciliation are unresolved. BNB and Monad privileged representation minting is recorded under Bridge Risk, not native issuance.

controls.label: Saturn sUSDat native ERC-4626 wrapper
controls.evidence: At Ethereum block 26108096, asset() returned the tracked USDat contract, decimals() returned 18, totalSupply() was 64,115,192.98239439 and paused() was false. The verified deployed source exposes deposit/mint share issuance against USDat rather than native creation of USDat. This is not a proof that upgrades, reserve accounting or all roles are harmless.

The current implementation, USDat asset, share supply, totalAssets and default-admin membership were re-observed at Ethereum block 26108096. Public custody/assurance prose remains on the legacy STRC structure, while the deployed vault holds STRCon. The unresolved review preserves observed adverse/local powers without asserting a complete safe control inventory or scoreable whole financial claim.
